title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency Re-Charge Span when Private Billing Resumes
content:
**Business office posting reference — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** When another payer source's coverage ends or is denied while the resident stays, the days of the advance-billed month after that coverage ended are charged again, at the private rate, as a re-charge span.

**Which month.** The re-charge span charges the days after another payer source's coverage ended that an advance charge of the agreement no longer bills, that advance being the agreement's room-and-board charge whose span begins latest — where two begin on the same day, the one posted first. An agreement that is not active again, still billed to the other payer source, is owed no re-charge span. Where the span works out to zero, no span is posted.

**What the span waits on.** The span re-charging the days after the other payer source's coverage ended is posted only after the advance charge billed for those days carries its payer-conversion credit.

## Posting tool: `post_resumed_recharge_e6f5843a`

**Capability.** Posts one room-and-board span charge on a private-pay admission agreement for days billed privately to a resident whose stay another payer source has stopped covering: one charge entry for the given service month, span dates, chargeable days, tier, daily rate and charge basis, which raises the agreement's private-pay balance by the charge amount; the span appears on the statement and ledger as its own charge line.

**How it is invoked.** An agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

**Parameters.**
- `private_agreement_id` — the reference number of the resident's private-pay admission agreement, as shown by the agreement lookup (id).
- `service_month` — the calendar month of service the span belongs to, YYYY-MM.
- `from_date` — the earliest day of the span, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `to_date` — the last day of the span, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `day_count` — the chargeable days of the span, a positive whole number.
- `accommodation_tier` — the tier whose daily rate prices the span, one of `Private Long-Term Care Room`, `Private Secure Memory Care Room`, `Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room`, `Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room`, `Private Bariatric Care Room`, `Private Suite with Sitting Area`.
- `daily_rate` — the daily rate applied, USD per day, 2 decimal places, positive.
- `charge_basis` — why the span is priced as it is, one of: `standard` (an ordinary span at the tier's own rate); `first_month_partial` (the admission month charged from the admission date); `isolation_rate` (a span priced at the isolation billing tier's rate while the center itself keeps the resident in the room for infection control); `prior_rate_notice_hold` (a span priced at the earlier scheduled rate because the written notice of the new rate has not yet run its notice period).
- `amount` — the charge in USD, positive, 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** On success: status "charged", the new ledger reference number, the service month, the first and last day, the day count, the tier, the daily rate, the charge basis, the amount, and the agreement's private-pay balance after the charge (negative means a credit balance). A zero or negative amount or daily rate, a month not written YYYY-MM, a date not written YYYY-MM-DD, or a day count that is not a positive whole number returns an error.
